candidates.review_note: Unprotected pairs are exactly pairs of zero entries lying in the same gap between shields, so maximizing protection minimizes sum C(gap_size,2). Shields never cross; their minimum movement cost is the sum of absolute differences between original and target counts of preceding zeros. DP processes shields, recording preceding-zero count and exact movement budget, and adds the triangular cost of each completed gap. For fixed prior budget, the transition min_t<=z(dp[t]+C(z-t,2)) is a lower envelope of lines with monotone slopes -2t evaluated at increasing z; a monotone convex hull computes all z in linear time using exact cross products. Charge abs(z-original_preceding_zeros) after each transition, add the final gap, and prefix-minimize over budgets to respect at-most k. Costs above ones*zeros cannot improve reachability. Handle all-shield and all-unshielded arrays directly.
